continuity: Jin Mukyung has returned after annihilating the enemy vanguard; the Heaven Shaking Squad suffered twenty-three deaths and thirty-seven wounded.
Jin Wikyung has evacuated people and troops from northern Shanxi, ordered the near-harvest fields burned, and prepared traps and iron caltrops along detours other than Jeongyang.
Five earthen forts are being built at Eight Spring Gorge; thousands of commoners have joined the defensive preparations, many out of gratitude for the Jin Family’s past aid.
The enemy has arrived at Eight Spring Gorge; Jin Wikyung has ordered the defenders to prepare for battle.

The Emperor remains gravely ill from Blood Soul Gu, and the Divine Physician says the only path to saving him requires him to die once; Taekyung’s quest to remove the Gu and treat him remains unresolved.
Jang Sam remains unconscious after his sudden rise in level and attack on Taekyung; the source and effects of the improved Temporary Strength Pill remain unknown.
The Martial God’s identity and connection to the chosen one and the Bow Saint remain unknown.
The Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s papers and silk pouch remain unexplained; the real Chinggen was killed, and an impostor wearing his face continues to accompany Jamukha.
plot: Jin Mukyung returns from a successful strike: his slightly more than two hundred Heaven Shaking Squad members annihilated a thousand enemy vanguard troops, including one hundred elite soldiers, at the cost of twenty-three dead and thirty-seven wounded. Jin Wikyung’s scorched-earth preparations, defenses at Eight Spring Gorge, and the support of thousands of commoners ready to help protect Shanxi are revealed; their loyalty stems in part from the Jin Family’s past aid during famine. As a rider arrives carrying a dead Jin Family martial artist, Jin Wikyung orders everyone to prepare for battle: the enemy has arrived.
translation_decisions: Render 토성 as “earthen fort” and 철질려 as “iron caltrops.” The carpenter’s remarks in this chapter address Jin Wikyung, not Jin Taekyung.

Who gave Jang Sam the silk pouch, and what are the improved pill’s effects and distribution?
What is the Martial God’s identity and connection to the chosen one and the Bow Saint?
What do the Eastern Heaven Demon Lord’s papers and silk pouch contain?

profile_updates.current: - **Personality:** Calm and politically capable, Jin Wikyung takes responsibility for his people and prioritizes their lives, but carries self-blame for past losses and can falter under the weight of a decision before resolving to act.
profile_updates.replacement: - **Personality:** Calm and politically capable, Jin Wikyung takes responsibility for his people and prioritizes their lives; he can agonize over costly decisions but commits firmly once resolved.

profile_updates.current: - **Relationships:** Jin Wikyung is Taekyung's eldest brother and future Family Head who protects and mentors him, commands Wipeng and the Jin Family's forces, has worked with Jeok Cheongang, maintains a political connection with Hongcheon, Prince Shangshan's hidden loyal retainer, and wants Taekyung to tell him his untold stories when the current crisis is over; Jin Mukyung is his younger brother and a potential successor alongside Taekyung.
